en: Colorized vintage view of a steep hillside with rocky cliffs and dense greenery, showing a funicular railway climbing up to a fortified hilltop complex. At the summit are walls, towers, and buildings with red-tiled roofs. In the center‑right stands a prominent clock tower. Handwritten notes run along the top margin, and printed caption text appears in blue near the top center.
